title: BeHot Yoga Toronto
specs: No experience needed, help provided to create experience
blurb: Guests attend yoga and Pilates classes in a welcoming and inclusive environment. New clients can start with an introductory two-week unlimited class offer. Memberships and class packages allow for flexible attendance options.
